items.headline: Alphabet stock suffers potentially historic drop as AI investment and weaker growth weigh on U.S. market
items.summary: Alphabet shares fell 12.9% as investors reacted to weaker-than-expected summer growth and higher AI-related spending. The company said purchases of property and equipment exceeded $51 billion, while free cash flow deteriorated. The sell-off weighed on the Nasdaq and broader market sentiment toward AI infrastructure spending.

items.headline: Google misses Wall Street expectations despite 25% revenue growth; shares fall after hours
items.summary: Alphabet reported third-quarter revenue of $127.58 billion, below the $127.97 billion analyst expectation, and earnings of $2.12 per share versus approximately $3.01 expected. Google Cloud revenue grew 103% to $30.7 billion, while Alphabet said 2027 capital expenditures are expected to increase significantly.
